resolution: FIXED the painted-roads-render-as-concrete bug. Root cause: framework/gpu/3d.zig uploaded each chunk's ground D reference stream with queue.writeBuffer using a byte size of `n * @sizeOf(f32)` WITHOUT a u64 cast, which overflowed a narrow integer (n=14528 gave 25344 bytes instead of 58112), so only ~6336 of 14528 floats reached the GPU buffer. Every cell past that read 0 = tile kind 0 (water) = material id 0 (concrete), so road/median/junction cells rendered concrete past ~local row 53 in each chunk. The vertex/instance writeBuffers already cast to u64; this one didn't. One-line fix: @as(u64, n) * @sizeOf(f32). Found by instrumenting the real ground formula and printing the write size (gn=14528 inline_bytes=25344 wbytes=58112 — the smoking gun) after a long bisection that ruled out data, the formula, uv mapping, normals, specular, and the staging. Verified on real GPU pixels via the road-render-test gate across z~10/52-173/111-114 and chunks (1,0)/(1,1): all render dark asphalt, gate PASSES; user confirmed on screen. Committed 1a66b5ac8.
